primaryTextRead.text: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z — Matred
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 英語版人物一覧は、マトレデをメザハブの娘として、歴代誌上1:50に基づき挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 項目はGenesis 36:39と1 Chronicles 1:50を明示し、MatredをMe-zahabの娘、Mehetabelの母と説明する。
